bayu.name: Bayu
bayu.voice: a mature, warm heroic male tenor
bayu.part: the man who keeps being born

lines.jv: Ing candhi tuwa, raimu tak ukir
lines.zh: 古老的石壁上，我刻下你的容颜
lines.en: At the old temple, I carve your face

lines.jv: Watu lan wektu dadi seksi katresnan
lines.zh: 石头与岁月，为这份爱作证
lines.en: Stone and time bear witness to love

lines.jv: Kowe liwat, mung sak kedhep mripat
lines.zh: 你走过，只在一眨眼之间
lines.en: You pass by, in one blink of an eye

lines.jv: Urip iki ora cukup kanggo nyandhing kowe
lines.zh: 这一生，不够我伴你身边
lines.en: This life is not enough to stand beside you

lines.jv: Ing kali wengi, keroncong nangis lirih
lines.zh: 夜的河上，琴声低低哭泣
lines.en: On the night river, the keroncong softly weeps

lines.jv: Kapal budhal, aku mlayu menyang dermaga
lines.zh: 船已起航，我奔向码头
lines.en: The ship departs, I run to the quay

lines.jv: Tanganku nggayuh, segara wis misahake
lines.zh: 我伸出手，大海已将我们隔开
lines.en: My hand reaches out, the sea already parts us

lines.jv: Urip iki maneh, aku kalah karo wektu
lines.zh: 这一生，我又输给了时间
lines.en: This life again, I lose to time

lines.jv: Yen iki dudu wektune
lines.zh: 若此刻还不是时候
lines.en: If this is not the time

lines.jv: Aku gelem ngenteni maneh
lines.zh: 我愿意，再等一回
lines.en: I will wait again

lines.jv: Mbesuk yen urip maneh, goleki aku
lines.zh: 来世若再相逢，请你把我寻找
lines.en: Someday, when we live again, look for me

lines.jv: Ing antarane sewu rai, aku ngerti kowe
lines.zh: 千万张面孔里，我一眼认出你
lines.en: Among a thousand faces, I will know you

lines.jv: Sanajan lintang wis ganti panggonan
lines.zh: 纵然星辰已换了位置
lines.en: Even if the stars have changed their places

lines.jv: Tresnaku ora bakal lali dalan mulih
lines.zh: 我的爱，不会忘记回家的路
lines.en: My love will not forget the way home

lines.jv: Wis kaping telu aku lair
lines.zh: 我已三度降生
lines.en: Three times now I have been born

lines.jv: Wis kaping telu aku kelangan
lines.zh: 我已三度失去
lines.en: Three times now I have lost

lines.jv: Kayon ditancepake, lakon durung rampung
lines.zh: 神山已立，这出戏还未落幕
lines.en: The kayon is planted, the story is not over

lines.jv: Saiki aku urip maneh, lan aku weruh kowe
lines.zh: 如今我再次活着，我看见了你
lines.en: Now I live again, and I see you

lines.jv: Ing ngarepe candhi, mesem kaya biyen
lines.zh: 在古老的庙前，笑得一如从前
lines.en: Before the temple, smiling as you did

lines.jv: Sanajan kowe lali, atiku isih kelingan
lines.zh: 纵然你已忘记，我的心还记得
lines.en: Though you forget, my heart remembers

lines.jv: Iki wektune, aja lunga maneh
lines.zh: 就是此刻，不要再离开
lines.en: This is the time, do not go away again

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: instrumental: quiet piano, one long held chord

about: Two souls keep missing each other across lifetimes in Java. A wayang gunungan sweeps across the frame to end each life. In the last life, a woman stops at an old temple relief that a stone carver made of her face.
